tasks.label: Check Custom Domain Cache
tasks.command: cmd /d /c "curl -s -H \"Cache-Control: no-cache\" https://caqualitysolutions.com/admin/dispatcher.html | findstr /c:\"Clocked In\" & curl -s -H \"Cache-Control: no-cache\" https://caqualitysolutions.com/customer-dashboard.html | findstr /c:\"Customer Portal\" & curl -s -H \"Cache-Control: no-cache\" https://caqualitysolutions.com/driver/dashboard.html | findstr /c:\"Customer Tracking\""

tasks.label: Check Custom Domain Markers
tasks.command: $d1 = curl.exe -s -H "Cache-Control: no-cache" "https://caqualitysolutions.com/admin/dispatcher.html"; $d2 = curl.exe -s -H "Cache-Control: no-cache" "https://caqualitysolutions.com/customer-dashboard.html"; $d3 = curl.exe -s -H "Cache-Control: no-cache" "https://caqualitysolutions.com/driver/dashboard.html"; Write-Output "-- dispatcher has Clocked In --"; ($d1 | Select-String -Pattern "Clocked In").Line; Write-Output "-- customer dashboard has Customer Portal --"; ($d2 | Select-String -Pattern "Customer Portal").Line; Write-Output "-- driver dashboard has Customer Tracking link text --"; ($d3 | Select-String -Pattern "Customer Tracking").Line

tasks.label: Create Full Role Backup
tasks.command: $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'; $dir = "backups/role_platform_full_$ts"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item "driver/dashboard.html","admin/dispatcher.html","admin/dashboard.html","customer-dashboard.html","customer/invoices.html","customer/profile.html" -Destination $dir -Force; Get-ChildItem $dir | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name

tasks.label: Create Full Role Backup Fixed
tasks.command: cmd /d /c "if not exist backups\role_platform_full_latest mkdir backups\role_platform_full_latest && copy /Y driver\dashboard.html backups\role_platform_full_latest\driver-dashboard.html && copy /Y admin\dispatcher.html backups\role_platform_full_latest\admin-dispatcher.html && copy /Y admin\dashboard.html backups\role_platform_full_latest\admin-dashboard.html && copy /Y customer-dashboard.html backups\role_platform_full_latest\customer-dashboard.html && copy /Y customer\invoices.html backups\role_platform_full_latest\customer-invoices.html && copy /Y customer\profile.html backups\role_platform_full_latest\customer-profile.html && dir /b backups\role_platform_full_latest"

tasks.label: Create Full Role Backup PS
tasks.command: $dest = 'backups/role_platform_full_latest'; if(-not (Test-Path $dest)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest | Out-Null }; Copy-Item 'driver/dashboard.html' "$dest/driver-dashboard.html" -Force; Copy-Item 'admin/dispatcher.html' "$dest/admin-dispatcher.html" -Force; Copy-Item 'admin/dashboard.html' "$dest/admin-dashboard.html" -Force; Copy-Item 'customer-dashboard.html' "$dest/customer-dashboard.html" -Force; Copy-Item 'customer/invoices.html' "$dest/customer-invoices.html" -Force; Copy-Item 'customer/profile.html' "$dest/customer-profile.html" -Force; Get-ChildItem $dest | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name
